output.one_liner: Linear is a streamlined issue tracking and project management tool for modern teams with fast workflows and GitHub integrations.

auth.notes: OAuth2 recommended for building applications for others; personal API keys suitable for scripts and direct user authentication

evidence.snippet: Linear supports OAuth2 authentication, which is recommended if you're building applications to integrate with Linear.
The Linear API supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication.
Authorization-code grants use refresh tokens; client-credentials grants do not.

access.notes: Users can create personal API keys directly in settings; OAuth applications created without approval or payment

evidence.snippet: Each user creates a personal API key in Linear under Settings > Security & access > Personal API keys and pastes it when connecting.
Create a new OAuth2 Application and configure the redirect callback URLs to your application.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: API key: 2,500 requests/hour; OAuth app: 5,000 requests/hour; complexity limits also apply

evidence.snippet: Linear's public API is built using GraphQL. It's the same API we use internally for developing our applications.
Linear provides webhooks which allow you to receive HTTP push notifications whenever data is created, updated or removed.
When authenticated using an API key you can make up to 2,500 requests per hour.
When making OAuth App requests, you are limited to 5,000 requests per hour.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve credentials, no cost, no approval required, well-documented GraphQL API with webhooks enables comprehensive toolkit development.

overview_evidence.snippet: Learn about building apps and integrations for Linear using the GraphQL API and TypeScript SDK.
Linear is a streamlined issue tracking and project planning tool for modern teams, featuring fast workflows, keyboard shortcuts, and GitHub integrations

unknown_reasons.mcp: Pages do not mention any official or community MCP servers for Linear
